Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{hidden_content: "Reachable"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
